productSummary.oneSentenceSummary: ContentGate is a WordPress plugin that allows site owners to restrict access to pages, posts, or entire websites based on user roles, login status, and other conditions.
productSummary.whatItDoes: ContentGate provides a visual rule builder to control who can view specific WordPress content without requiring any coding. It allows users to create access rules based on user role, logged-in status, registration date, and other criteria, and apply restrictions to individual pages, posts, post types, taxonomies, menu items, or the entire website.
targetUsers: Content creators with private or member content
Businesses managing client areas or intranets
Anyone needing content restriction on WordPress

features.name: Visual Rule Builder
features.description: Create access rules using a visual interface without writing any code. Build conditional logic like 'IF visitor is logged out → hide this page' through a simple interface.
evidence: Easy Rule Builder: Make rules like 'IF visitor is logged out → hide this page.' Build complex logic visually with zero code.
ContentGate is built for WordPress users, not developers. No shortcodes, no PHP, no headaches.
Use the visual rule builder to define your condition — like user login status and user role.

features.name: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Target specific WordPress user roles including built-in roles (Contributors, Editors, Admins) or any custom roles created on the site.
evidence: Role-Based Control: Target specific WordPress user roles — Contributors, Editors, Admins, or any custom role you've created.
Choose who sees content based on user role, logged-in status, registration date and more.

features.name: Instant Rule Activation
features.description: Toggle any access rule on or off instantly to test restrictions in real-time without modifying theme files or functions.php.
evidence: Instant Activation: Toggle any rule on or off instantly. Test restrictions in real-time without touching theme files or functions.php.
Toggle the rule on. Your content is now protected — instantly, reliably, beautifully.

features.name: Custom Restriction Messages
features.description: Display fully editable messages to visitors when they don't have access to restricted content. Messages can be branded and include links.
evidence: Simple Restriction Message: Add fully editable message that visitors see when they don't have access to a post or page.
Write the message visitors see when they're restricted. Brand it, link it, make it yours.

features.name: Whole Site Lock
features.description: Apply a single access rule to protect the entire WordPress site, requiring approval for users to view any content.
evidence: Whole Site Lock: Put your entire WordPress site behind a single access rule. Only approved users can view anything at all.
Select specific pages, posts, or toggle on 'Whole Site' to protect everything at once.

features.name: Granular Content Protection
features.description: Restrict access to specific pages, posts, post types, taxonomies (categories, tags, custom taxonomies), or menu items.
evidence: Pages: Hide any page you want. Perfect for private lessons, dashboards, or client pages.
Posts: Keep certain blog posts private so only the right people can read them.
Post Type: Control who sees specific content types, like pages or posts.
Taxonomy: Hide categories, tags, or custom taxonomies to control access to specific topics.
Menu Items: Restrict access to specific menu items: keep some pages hidden from certain users.

features.name: Multiple Restriction Criteria
features.description: Create rules based on user role, logged-in status, registration date, and other user attributes.
evidence: Choose who sees content based on user role, logged-in status, registration date and more.
Restrict Who You Want: Choose who sees content based on user role, logged-in status, registration date and more.

howTos.title: Set Up Content Restriction in ContentGate
steps: Install the Plugin: Download and activate ContentGate from the WordPress plugin directory
Create what to Protect: Use the visual rule builder to define your condition (such as user login status and user role)
Choose what to Protect: Select specific pages, posts, or toggle on 'Whole Site' to protect everything at once
Customize the Message: Write the message visitors see when they're restricted, including branding and links as needed
Activate & Done: Toggle the rule on to immediately protect your content
